_readme: Human-defined settings. Edit here; the AI works INSIDE these limits and cannot change or bypass them (a violated safety condition always takes priority and blocks the recipe). Every entry states its source/status.

outlet_criteria.source: Read from the team's 'Proof of Concept' poster slide (criteria of out water). The legal document behind it is NOT cited on the poster -> verify.

raw_water_criteria.source: Same poster slide (criteria of raw water). Verify.

ozone_air_exposure.source: OSHA permissible exposure limit for ozone (29 CFR 1910.1000 Table Z-1). Verify against the current OSHA/NIOSH page; Egyptian requirements may differ.

max_consistency_pct_for_this_hardware.why: Small diaphragm pump + PVC tube; fibre-suspension handling NOT validated. 3 % is the lowest consistency in the literature tables (P3, Hand-mixing row of the patent).

tss_prefilter_trigger_mg_L.why: Suspended solids consume ozone; no validated threshold exists for this device.

plateau_stop_pct.why: Stop when the absorbance changes by less than this between two consecutive samples.

poster_reference_run.note: Not measured in this project's data.

min_own_records_for_own_model.why: Minimum number of OUR OWN wastewater runs before the app fits a model on them. It was chosen by the app developers as a rough floor. It is NOT from a paper or dataset, it is NOT a count of experiments we performed, and no statistical justification has been checked -> NEEDS TEAM DECISION / SOURCE before it is described as adequate.

range_tolerance_fraction.why: Inputs beyond the training range by more than this fraction of the range are RED (unsupported); inside the tolerance they are YELLOW.

operating_pH_window_default.why: Literature tested pH 0.26-9.6, but pH < 2 needs strong-acid handling that has NOT been assessed for this rig (pump, PVC fittings, exposed breadboard wiring). Default lower bound 2.0; lowering it is a conscious human decision.

control_pH_and_temperature_in_design.why: The team states pH 6.3 and 25 C are natural sample conditions. By default the experiment planner therefore varies only treatment duration. Set true only if the team decides to deliberately control pH/temperature.

device_specs_from_poster.note: null = UNKNOWN. Not stated on the poster and not measurable from the photos. Must be measured/calibrated.

hardware.item: PVC pipe contact column (horizontal, on wooden board)
hardware.unknowns: internal volume, length, diameter, material rating for ozone

hardware.item: Small diaphragm/mini liquid pump (white head, DC motor)
Breadboard with 3 blue LEDs ('energy recovery' claim)
hardware.unknowns: energy actually recovered is NOT measured here

hardware.item: Ozone generator ~15 W with air stone (white 'ozonizer' unit)
Pulp brightness meter (ISO 2470) / colorimeter for L*a*b*
Ozone off-gas destructor / ozone gas monitor
hardware.unknowns: must be confirmed before any run
photos show exposed breadboard wiring beside a water container

hardware.item: Precipitation / adsorption stage for heavy metals
hardware.unknowns: ozone alone does not remove metals

team_specification._source: Team's handwritten notes + voice note (2026-10-04). TEAM-STATED, not independently measured here. Verify against the ozonizer label/manual before publication.

ozone_generation_max.note: The handwritten note is hard to read (mg/hr vs ml/hr). mg O3/hour is the usual unit for an ozone generator's OUTPUT RATE; it is a rate, not a concentration. Confirm on the ozonizer label/manual.

water_temperature_C.condition_type: NATURAL / background sample condition (measured, not adjusted)

sample_pH.condition_type: NATURAL / background sample condition (measured, not adjusted)
sample_pH.note: The handwritten note first shows 7, corrected by hand to 6.3. The poster's two PoC samples show pH 7.13 / 7.07 - the team must state which sample the 6.3 belongs to (NEEDS CLARIFICATION).
